latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Caption Generator.

- Instantly add captions or subtitles to any uploaded video (supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, and more).
- No timeline editing or manual export settings required; just describe the captions you want.
- Automatic authentication and backend session setup with 100 free credits for new users.
- Supports captioning in multiple languages and quick 1080p exports.
- Simple text-based commands for uploading, exporting, checking credits, and editing workflows.
- Cloud GPU processing; finished 1080p captioned videos ready in 30–60 seconds for most clips.
